scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n packages,server,web,demo "tsup --config tsup.dev.config.ts" "cd apps/server && tsx watch src/main.ts" "cd apps/viewer && ./node_modules/.bin/vite" "cd apps/demo && node scripts/dev.mjs"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ida-dev/core && npm run build -w @ida-dev/adapter-eventemitter -w @ida-dev/adapter-eventtarget -w @ida-dev/adapter-kafkajs -w @ida-dev/adapter-amqplib -w @ida-dev/cloud
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ida-dev/server && npm run build -w @ida-dev/viewer
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-eventemitter && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-eventtarget && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-kafkajs && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-amqplib && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cloud && tsc --noEmit -p apps/viewer && tsc --noEmit -p apps/demo && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server
scripts.demo:brokers: sh examples/brokers/pack.sh && docker compose -f examples/brokers/compose.yaml up --build
